name: Water Hazard
abilities: Hydrokinesis - controls ambient water, makes water whips and cushions
Pressurised water blasts from hand portholes (fire-hose force; smashes walls, launches foes)
Water/moisture absorption from the air (creates water from hydrogen and oxygen)
summary: One of the Andromeda Five aliens, a red armoured mollusk who fires fire-hose water blasts from his palms and pulls moisture out of thin air.
traits: Mouth does not move when he speaks
notableFeats: Impersonated Bivalvan to try to talk P'Andor down (Too Hot to Handle)
Defeated Overlord by absorbing moisture from the air (Hero Time)
Beat Swamps before being frozen by Fridge (Double or Nothing)
Battled Buglizard with Rook (The More Things Change: Part 2)
Defeated Ultimate Panuncian (For a Few Brains More)
Flooded Pakmar's shop fighting Sir Morton (Bengeance is Mine)

appearances.designNotes: Red mollusk armour with grey lower torso, black spots on shoulders/legs, grey mouth that does not move, two green eyes, hand portholes; Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

Taller, thinner and darker maroon with violet greys; four slitted eyes, eye-like chest markings and rib-like crab features on the stomach, barnacle portholes on shoulders/arms/legs/hands, rougher hexagonal hood, dactyl-like sharp fingers; Omnitrix on chest.

image.label: OV

scoring.rationale: Tough armoured shell (durability 8) with fire-hose water blasts that knocked out Overlord and Ultimate Panuncian and hydrokinesis for whips and cushions; breathes underwater and shrugs off radiation. Slow, limited range, and heat/electricity get through.

notes: Wiki title is 'Waterhazard'; project name is 'Water Hazard'.
UA 'Night of the Living Nightmare' entry was a figment in a dream (cameo), not a transformation.
UA wearer: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix.
